---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a change to the site or to what it says
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / motivation
What is missing or unclear on the site, and for whom?

## Proposed change
New content, a new section, a change of wording or of design.

## Where
The page and the section it concerns.

## Constraints
The site is static: no backend, no forms, no cookies and no third-party scripts. Say so if the proposal needs any of them.

## Additional context
Mockups, screenshots or links to prior art are welcome.
